Select your preferred package manager to view installation instructions for
zen-do.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Cargo

First, install [Rust](https://rust-lang.org/tools/install/) and Cargo. Then
install zen-do from [crates.io](https://crates.io) with

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
cargo install zen-do
```

To confirm that zen-do was installed correctly, run:

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
zen-do --version
```

If the `zen-do` command cannot be found, try restarting your terminal. If you
still have issues after that, check that the installation directory is on your
`PATH` so you can run Cargo installs the zen-do executable in the following
directory by default:

- **macOS or Linux:** `$HOME/.cargo/bin`
- **Windows:** `%USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin`

## uv

:::: callout-tip
If you prefer to not install zen-do as a standalone command, you can use `uvx`
to install and run it in one step instead. To use `uvx` with zen-do, prefix the
command invocation with `uvx` each time you type out a zen do command:

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
uvx zen-do --version
```

::::

First, install [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv). Then install zen-do from PyPI
with

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
uv tool install zen-do
```

To confirm that zen-do was installed correctly, run:

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
zen-do --version
```

To upgrade zen-do with uv, you can run:

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
uv tool upgrade --all
```
